card.name: Numbers just before a unit of measure
card.fires_on: A number (or a number-scale word like light or billion) in a quantity, right before the unit word such as years, weeks, meters, tons or Units.

modes.label: Duration numbers
modes.description: A digit giving a length of time, just before years or weeks.
modes.example: After an average follow-up of <<4>> years, 40 women being treated

modes.label: Measurement numbers
modes.description: A number or scale word in a distance, weight or amount, just before the unit.
modes.example: about 264<< billion>> tons of which are recoverable

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a dose amount before Units.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a noun-like next word and away from unit or moment words, so the unit word is not guessed too early.
card.plain: It fires on a number in a quantity, just before the unit word like years, weeks or tons.
